races.name: Willis Towers Watson Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict: Highly tried in juvenile hurdles last season and fit from a recent spin on the flat, MICHONNE looks the pick at the weights on return to maiden company. Hurdling debutant Bunker Buster showed bags of ability in bumpers and is feared most, with Gordon Elliott's Ivatt completing the shortlist.

runners.note: Half-brother to stable's useful hurdler Shoot First. Well backed when placing in solid bumpers at Navan/Punchestown last season, showing bags of ability amid keenness. May well benefit from the addition of a first-time h
Hurdling debutant who showed ability (modest form) in 4 bumper starts this summer. Will probably have better opportunities down the line.
Beaten 4 lengths when last of 3 finishers on sole start in points. Shaped as if better for the run on hurdling debut at Cork in the spring. May still need this following 4 months away.

Fairly useful middle-distance handicapper on Flat. Improved on his hurdling debut form when smooth-travelling fifth at Navan (2m), not as well suited by the long run-in as the other principals. In top hands and could mus
Low-grade Flat winner never landed a blow in a Listowel maiden (200/1) 9 days ago. Little appeal this side of handicaps.
Hasn't shown much in either code. Back hurdling and needs this run for a mark.
Wasn't unduly punished to make some late gains second time up over hurdles at Navan (2m, good to soft, 300/1). Still easy enough to look elsewhere.

€5,000 3-y-o, Valirann gelding. Half-brother to useful chaser Charlie Uberalles and modest hurdler Atomic Angel. Dam unraced, out of unraced sister to useful hurdler/smart chaser (2½m-3¼m winner) Hell's Bay. Cheap purcha
Shaped better than the beaten distance when well-held sixth on second bumper start at Killarney (17f). Entitled to need the experience now switched to hurdles following 4 months off.
Cloth of Stars gelding. Dam unraced sister to French 2¼m hurdle winner We Will See. Placed on second of 2 point starts in April. Market should guide now sent hurdling by capable new yard.
Sumbal filly. Dam pulled up sole start in points. Isn't an obvious sort on breeding but at least worth a market check given who trains her.

Fairly useful stayer on the Flat. Improved with each hurdle start last season, finishing runner-up in listed juvenile at Naas (solid form) prior to facing a stiff task in Fairyhouse Grade 2. Recent return on Flat (well b

From a good jumping family. Showed a bit at long odds when distant third in Limerick bumper in March. Still very green in the face of a stiff task in Grade 3 at Punchestown the following month. At least worth noting for

races.name: bet365 Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict: Lightly-raced 3-y-o AMALOU may be able to follow up her Windsor win if blinkers have the same effect. Arlecchino's Rex has rock-solid claims for a third course victory, while Tiger Beetle could be interesting off a falling mark with blinkers refitted.

runners.note: Course regular. Landed his first win away from this venue when tackling 1½m for the first time at Lingfield earlier this month. Ran at least as well in defeat when 1¼-length third over C&D latest, deserving additional cr

Matched best of his recent form when third at Chepstow on penultimate start. Wasn't disgraced/extended long losing run in Lingfield classified event in cheekpieces latest. Makes some appeal, with blinkers back on for fir

Quirky maiden who's been sent off at long odds on all previous starts. Ran respectably when beaten 13 lengths at Bath (1¾m) latest. Plenty on at the weights trying 1½m/this surface for the first time.

Opened her account in a 3-y-o C&D handicap in April. Ran better than for a while when beaten 4 lengths in first-time cheekpieces here latest. Needs a bit more to reverse form with Arlecchino's Rex, even with good-value c

Proved a different proposition in blinkers when making her second handicap start a winning one at Windsor, pulling clear with runner-up on long run-in. A sharper track may not be ideal, however, she's relatively fresh/un

Placed 3 times in maiden company last summer. Went close in classified company at Ripon (1¼m, soft) in late-August. Wasn't as strong at the finish when 3 lengths fourth on first crack at 1½m at Newcastle subsequently. Ma
Hasn't beaten a rival to date, latterly in first-time cheekpieces on qualifying run at Lingfield (1¼m, 125/1). Hard to be confident she'll make an impact now handicapping over even further.

Low-mileage 3-y-o. Beat rivals for the first time in handicap company when dropped into this grade at Newcastle (1¼m) last time, finishing 7 lengths sixth of 11. No guarantee she builds on that back up in trip.

Finished 6 lengths fourth in a Southwell maiden (7f) this time last year. Only matched that form in handicaps, not helped by his free-going ways on recent starts over 1½m/1¾m (isn't bred to stay this far).
Hasn't kicked on since placing on first 2 handicap starts at Newcastle (1¼m) in April/May. Always behind on return to that track (1½m) last time.

races.name: David Clarke Memorial 'National Hunt' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: RIDE LIKE A GIRL holds the clear edge on form and looks to have been found a good opportunity to bag a second success over hurdles. Tom George has his string in excellent nick and his Worcester bumper scorer Dark Tide Rising appeals as the one to chase home Jamie Snowden's mare ahead of fellow hurdling newcomer Whin Cover.

runners.note: Little promise shown in a trio of bumpers (trained by Rebecca Menzies first 2 starts) and 2 runs over hurdles, tried in a hood at Sedgefield (2½m, firm) last time.
Ocovango gelding has finished fourth in bumpers at Kelso and here in early summer. Goes hurdling now after a break and needs to step forward in all likelihood.

Fair bumper winner. Had a breathing operation before opening her hurdles account in 2m handicap at Huntingdon in May. Runner-up in 2m novice events at Uttoxeter and Bangor since. Holds leading form claims.

Looked in need of the experience in 2 bumpers last year for Paul Collins. Off 14 months (had breathing operation) before taking a step forward for new yard with fifth of 10 in bumper at Worcester (2m, good) 40 days ago,

Fourth in an Irish point. Much improved on second bumper run when a wide-margin winner of 9-runner event at Worcester (2m, good) 4 weeks ago, though left clear at start and never challenged. Yard is going very well so mu

€3,000 3-y-o, £3,000 5-y-o, Shirocco mare. Half-sister to fairly useful 23f hurdle winner Chigorin and fairly useful hurdler/chaser Le Coq Hardi. Unplaced in Irish points. Market can guide now going hurdling.

Failed to go on after a promising start over hurdles for Gordon Elliott last season. Off 12 months (first-time tongue tie) when a well-held fourth of 6 for new stable in novice at Plumpton (21f, good to firm) 12 days ago

races.name: Autumn Racing Weekend Amateur Jockeys' Handicap (Male Amateurs)
races.verdict: This is wide open. TEX has gained both his victories here (first over C&D) and scored in good style in amateur company last time out so is fancied to defy a 6 lb weights rise with Simon Walker a significant booking. Recent Ffos Las winner Kaleidoscope Eyes heads the list of dangers under a 5-lb penalty, although Rock Opera is weighted to go well and represents last year's successful connections. N

runners.note: Doubled his tally with 7f win at Southwell last October. Resumed with encouraging fifth at Kempton (1m) in July on final run for James Tate. Raced too freely (got no cover) when a respectable fourth of 6 in handicap at S
A fair 6f winner in 2025. Mainly below par this season, only ninth of 12 in handicap here (5f, good to firm) 27 days ago. Takes a big step up in trip now.
Took a while to get off the mark but doubled his tally at Lingfield (1m) in August. Backed it up with a good second of 11 to Tex in handicap here (1m, good) 4 weeks ago. Up 6 lb here though.
Ended a losing run at Salisbury (1m) in August. Has posted good-placed efforts in handicaps at Goodwood (9f) and Sandown (1m) since. Must enter calculations nudged up 1 lb.
Sole win came at Newbury (6.5f) in June 2023. Running consistently well this summer though, second of 9 in handicap at Ayr (7f, heavy) 13 days ago. Ought to be thereabouts again.
Opened his account over C&D in July and comfortably doubled his tally in amateurs' handicap here (1m, good) 4 weeks ago by ¾ length from Dannick. Up 6 lb but a player with Simon Walker now up.
Landed eighth win at Windsor (6f) in June. In good form since until only seventh of 9 in handicap there (6f, good to soft) last time. The sort to bounce back.
Now firmly into the veteran stage but gained a 13th career success in 12-runner handicap at Doncaster (7f, firm) in August. This C&D scorer can't be ruled out despite 3 lb rise.
Doubled his tally at Windsor (1m) in July. Back on track with third of 14 in handicap at Newmarket (9f, good to firm) 13 days ago. Possibilities.

Fair ex-French 7f/1m winner for Xavier Blanchet. Last of 10 in minor event at Deauville (9.5f) sole run for M. Delzangles in August but no surprise to see him bounce back for new yard. Wears tongue strap.

Free-going type who is much improved for Charlie Clover this season, winning for the third time at Haydock (7f) in August. Posted another good effort when third of 9 in handicap at Epsom (7f, good) 22 days ago. Can make

Scored at Chelmsford (7f) in February and has recorded plenty of solid efforts since, not enjoying a smooth passage when fourth of 12 in handicap at Newmarket (1m, good to firm) 8 days ago. Should go well again.
Quirky sort who ended a long losing sequence (in refitted hood) in 13-runner classified event at Doncaster (1m, good to firm) 3 weeks ago. Not out of things with headgear retained.

Back to winning ways at Pontefract (6f) in June but below that level on his last 4 starts, just tenth of 12 in 6f handicap at Southwell latest. Now only 1 lb above his last winning mark so needs considering for last year

Finally off the mark at Carlisle (7f) and followed up with a ready success at Ayr (5f) later in summer. Not disgraced when thirteenth of 20 in handicap at Ripon (6f, good to firm) last time given she was left poorly plac
Registered 7f handicap wins at Doncaster and Yarmouth (7f) in July. Below par in 3 runs since however so bounce back is needed in a change of headgear.

A fair 7f winner in 2025. Yet to add to it this season but largely running well, including when an unlucky-in-running sixth of 12 in handicap at Leicester (6f, good to firm) 11 days ago. Well in the mix.
Proved better than ever as she doubled her tally for the year in 10-runner handicap at Ffos Las (1m, heavy) 5 days ago. Not taken lightly under a 5-lb penalty.

races.name: Cantor Fitzgerald Ireland Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict: Fairly-useful Flat performer COSMIC FRONT was undone by a bad mistake on her hurdles debut at Down Royal and is entitled to build on that. She gets the nod. The Captain's Word and Midfield Magic rate the principal dangers.

runners.note: €20,000 Mahler gelding was off mark in points at second attempt (Jan 10) but accomplished little on Rules debut at Fairyhouse 7 months ago.
Sent off big odds and went with little promise in novice hurdle at Roscommon on NH debut 59 days ago, falling late on when well beaten.
Poet's Word gelding.  Well beaten on both outings in maiden hurdles at Naas. Not seen for 7 months.
Promise in bumper on NH debut last summer but offered little over hurdles or back in a bumper at Kilbeggan in May.
Youmzain gelding. Dam unraced. Made frame both starts in points, runner-up last time (May 2026). Likely a longer-term prospect.

€24,000 5-y-o, Order of St George gelding. Brother to useful hurdler George's Lad, and half-brother to fairly useful hurdler/fair chaser Will Sting. Off mark in points in May and is worth monitoring in the market on NH d
Famous Name gelding. Dam modest maiden hurdler (stayed 2¾m) out of 2m-19f chase winner Lirfox. Wears hood. Pulled up sole start in points last winter and is likely best watched on NH debut.

€165,000 3-y-o, Authorized gelding. Dam, 2¼m chase winner in France, sister to dual Cheltenham Gold Cup winner Al Boum Photo. Appeals on pedigree and won a point earlier this year. Interesting newcomer.
Made promising start when second of 10 in bumper at Clonmel in May. Likely more to come on hurdles debut.
Placed in points but finished well beaten in bumper at Punchestown on NH debut 154 days ago. Can only be watched on hurdles debut for new yard.
Exceeded market expectations when fourth of 25 in maiden hurdle at Fairyhouse on debut in April. Since joined Gavin Cromwell and surely has more to offer yet.
Some encouragement on bumper debut but run poorly in a couple of starts in this sphere.
Made frame both starts in points and posted encouraging third of 16 in bumper at Punchestown (2m, good to soft) on NH debut 153 days ago. Merits consideration on hurdles bow.
Showed ability in a couple of bumpers, latest when fourth of 10 at Kilbeggan last month. Warrants respect on hurdles debut.
Well held only outing in bumpers and didn't achieve much in a couple of hurdle starts earlier this year. Since joined new yard and looks up against it here.

Fairly useful Flat performer, successful on latest start in February (all 3 wins on all-weather). In top hands and shaped better than the distance beaten when sixth of 10 in novice hurdle at Down Royal on NH debut 35 day

Kapgarde mare. Half-sister to fair hurdler Despereaux and French hurdler Sassari. Dam French hurdler/chaser. Winning pointer but pulled up when last seen in that sphere in May. Likely to need more time.
Poet's Word mare who had shown a bit by the line on her debut when well-beaten seventh of 15 in maiden hurdle at Roscommon (2m, good) in July. Likely one for handicaps down the line.
No impact in either bumper outing and can only be watched on switch to hurdling.
Went with little promise in novice hurdle at Down Royal on NH debut 35 days ago.
Telecaster gelding. Half-brother to French hurdler/chaser Le Philosophe. Dam 1½m/13f winner in France. Market should prove best guide to claims on debut. RESERVE.
Point winner who made the frame in first 2 starts in bumpers. Not in same form at Clonmel when last seen in March but warrants respect on hurdles debut. RESERVE.

races.name: Rockspur CIC EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: LOWCOUNTRY went on the bridle longer than any bar the winner at this course 17 days ago and is taken to strike at the third time of asking with the drop to 5f looking a good move. Classic Bellini finished third at Wetherby in June and must enter the reckoning back from a break with her yard firmly amongst the winners, while Anna Belardo shouldn't be far away if reproducing his latest effort.

runners.note: Left debut form well behind when third in 10-runner novice at this course (6f) 17 days ago, encouragingly going on the bridle longer than any bar the winner. Has to be of interest with the drop to 5f a potentially good m
Belatedly back to something like his solid debut form when second of 6 in first-time cheekpieces here (6f) last time. Sure to be in the mix if reproducing that back at 5f.
Proved very green but hinted at ability when sixth of 10 in novice at this course (6f) on debut 17 days ago, missing break. Looks one for handicaps later on.
A cheap purchase given his pedigree and went backwards from his debut when eighth of 10 in novice (9/2) at this course (6f) 17 days ago. Probably more one for handicaps after this run.

Foaled April 3. 2,500 gns foal, 10,000 gns yearling, 16,000 gns 2-y-o, Twilight Son colt. Half-brother to 7f-1¼m winner Orbital and useful 2-y-o 7f winner Moon Target. Well worth a market check debuting in an ordinary ma

Fared best of the newcomers when staying on for sixth in 13-runner maiden at Yarmouth (6f, good to firm) in June. However, went backwards from that opening effort at Windsor 11 weeks later. Bounce back required.
Winless in 8 starts and followed a below-par effort with an even-worse one in 6f nursery at Southwell 15 days ago. Plenty to prove.
Went backwards from debut when fifth of 7 in 5f maiden at Bath (good to soft) 19 days ago.
Shaped better than first time up when third of 6 in 5½f novice at Wetherby (firm) in June and must enter calculations back from a break, especially with her yard amongst the winners.

races.name: Martin Bowler Memorial Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: This can go DANTE'S INFERNO, who was clear of the remainder when a close second at Market Rasen last week and can race off the same mark here. Drumlee Myth and Knockeranna Rose may give him most to think about.

runners.note: Left previous hurdle efforts behind when winning on reappearance at Cartmel (2¾m) in July. Not in quite same form at Perth last time but must enter calculations.
Off the mark in Irish points at seventh attempt but yet to make an impact in a trio of hurdles for current yard. May do better now sent handicapping, though.
Remains a maiden but got back on track with placed efforts both starts in April. Ran poorly when last seen here in the summer but figures off a handy mark if returning in better form.
Remains a maiden under both codes and finished well held in last start over hurdles here in June. Makes limited appeal.
Unpromising in points and similar story in 4 starts over hurdles, including on handicap debut at Perth last month.

Posted career best in first-time cheekpieces (retained) when very good second of 11 in handicap hurdle over shorter trip at Market Rasen 6 days ago. Can race off an unchanged mark and holds obvious claims.
Long-standing maiden under Rules who hasn't got going at all this season, dropping away quickly at Sedgefield last month. Best watched.

races.name: BetMGM EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: LEARNING continued her race-by-race progression when runner-up in a conditions event at Newbury a fortnight ago, giving a good account from the front, and she could be ready to get off the mark this time around. Pink Larkspur is feared most after her promising second at Kempton on debut, ahead of Concurrent.

runners.note: Made plenty of appeal on paper and showed ability amidst inexperience when fifth of 8 in maiden at Salisbury on debut in September. One to note with yard's runners often learning plenty from their first outing.

Foaled February 13. Night of Thunder filly. Closely related to smart winner up to 7f Dubawi Legend and half-sister to 3 winners, including useful 1¼m-1½m winner Golden Pass. Trainer's newcomers tend to be better for thei

Foaled March 3. 80,000 gns yearling, Kingman filly. Dam, 5f-6f winner, half-sister to smart 5.5f-1m winner Love Spirit. Yard capable of readying one on debut, so she's worth a market check with stable also represented by
Has progressed with each of her 3 starts so far, taking on 3 previous winners and acquitting herself very well when second of 4 in conditions stakes at Newbury 2 weeks ago. Leading contender.
Showed plenty to work on first time up when second of 6 in novice at Kempton 23 days ago, the winner looking a bright prospect in making it 2 from 2. Respected with improvement to come.

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Pat Walsh Memorial Mares Hurdle
races.verdict: Last year's winner ROYAL HOLLOW has likely been aimed at a repeat bid and ran well on the Flat last month. She makes plenty of appeal. Daboya and Gino Bella are feared most.

runners.note: Well held on Flat latest but successful in last 2 starts in this sphere, latest at Bellewstown in August. Likely contender.
Three-time winner last season but ran poorly when last seen at Punchestown in April. Others more convincing.
Fairly useful hurdler at best but yet to fire in a trio of starts over longer trips for Emmet Mullins this season. Can't be discounted, though.
Fairly useful hurdler who took this prize last season. Arrives on back of creditable fifth on Flat at Clonmel 16 days ago and looks the one to beat again.
Fairly useful hurdler who has won 2 of her 4 starts this season and arrives on back of creditable third of 10 in handicap hurdle at Killarney 43 days ago. This is tougher but she warrants respect.
Had been knocking on the door prior to making the most of a good opportunity in a C&D maiden in March. Below par at Fairyhouse the following month, though, and faces a stiff task here.

Quirky sort who was given too much rope when successful on hurdling debut at Sligo in August and improved in the face of better opposition when runner-up in a mares conditions race at Bellewstown next time. Not in same f

races.name: bet365 Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: INKBERROW looked the winner for much of the straight on her C&D debut 17 days ago and this looks an excellent opportunity for her to get off the mark. Lahan Kingman and Ventana both hold claims on the pick of their form but come here on the back of poor runs.

runners.note: Finished last of 12 on debut over C&D (500/1) 17 days ago and is impossible for fancy.

Promising second of 12 over C&D on debut 17 days ago, looking the winner for much of the straight before outstayed by one with more experience. Entitled to come on for that initial outing and will be hard to beat.
12,000 gns yearling. Kodi Bear filly. 12,000Y. Sister to useful 6f/7f winner Noor Bano. Likely to need the experience.
Ran to a similar level when in frame on her first 4 starts before disappointing on soft going at Chester last time. Place claims returned to all-weather.
Fair form shown to date, finishing mid-field in a handicap at Chester over 7f last time. Didn't shape like this drop back to 6f was what she needed so looks best opposed.
Showed only greenness when last of 7 at Leicester on debut 12 months ago. Not seen since and now starts out after a breathing operation.
Claims on second of 10 at Windsor in June but finished last of 9 in a handicap at Newmarket later that month. Reportedly bled that day and now returns from 104 days off.

races.name: Jewson Hexham Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: MOVEIT LIKE MINNIE and Mr Mcloughlan may battle this out for a pair of in-form yards, the former narrowly preferred on the pick of last season's efforts. Banderas appeals most of the remainder.

runners.note: Had strong handicap form at the beginning of last season, notably his third behind Alexei at Ascot. Gained reward for his consistency in Class 3 event at Wincanton in March and can be forgiven subsequent end-of-season ef

Successful 3 times in the early part of last season. Performed with credit in good-quality handicaps subsequently, doing a bit much early when beaten 7 lengths in the Swinton on final start for Jack Jones. Interesting wi

Strong-travelling type. Resumed progress over hurdles when winning a 2½m course handicap in May. Lost nothing in defeat on the Flat the following month. Still on a handy mark over hurdles, though this drop back in trip i

Maiden who finished third in back-to-back handicaps at Wexford for J. P. Dempsey last summer. Shaped quite well when beaten 8½ lengths in a solid Market Rasen handicap on stable debut/return in July. Interesting if build

races.name: Colliers Business Rates Experts Classified Stakes (Str)
races.verdict: With 3-y-os having an excellent recent record in this race, it may pay to concentrate on COCKADE and Princling, who have both won fresh previously. John & Thady Gosden's charge narrowly shades the vote, with Collecting Coin the pick of the older horses.

runners.note: Reliable performer who improved a little further to score for the third time in 2026 at Goodwood (1¼m, good to soft) latest, travelling well under a typically patient ride. He's plainly a better horse than when campaigne

Cemented his fine start for present yard when length fifth of 17 in a Premier Handicap at Leopardstown (7f) last time. Caught the eye with how he travelled that day and still relatively unexposed over 1m. Interesting con

All 4 successes to date have come over 1m at Kempton. Has at least matched that form on turf in recent starts, continuing in good heart when 3 lengths fourth (suffered some interference) at Haydock last time. May prove v

Smart runner-up in 1¼m Group 1 at Randwick in October 2024. No impact in handicaps for present yard since returning from an absence. A further 4 lb reprieve does see him drop into calmer waters here, though, and isn't on

Low-mileage 4-y-o who's a half-brother to a smart one on the Flat. Underperformed on handicap bow at Galway (8.5f) prior to making it 3 wins from 4 starts (including maiden hurdle win) when successful at Laytown (7f) las

Dual 7f winner in France for Francis-Henri Graffard. Back to his useful best for current yard with runner-up finishes on 2 of his last 3 starts, chasing home an in-form front runner at Sandown (7f) latest. Respected tryi

Made hay in Dundalk claimers prior to a successful stable debut at Kempton (1m) in July. Backed that up when runner-up in a highly competitive Glorious Goodwood (7f) handicap. Slow start didn't help his cause at Doncaste

From an excellent family that connections know well. Confirmed the promise of his strong debut form when winning on reappearance at Windsor (1m). Underdone by lingering greenness when third at Newmarket subsequently. Has

Improving 3-y-o. Sealed a third success from 4 starts with a good turn of foot at Sandown last time, winning easily despite not looking entirely straightforward. Ought to be suited by the bigger field here, however, face

A 6-figure breeze-up buy with a smart pedigree. Won pair of all-weather novices as a juvenile. Placed twice in handicaps at Chester/Hamilton earlier this season and hasn't faced his ideal set-up on his most recent couple

Strong 2-y-o form prior to making a winning return at Wetherby in April. Couldn't repeat his fine 2½-length fifth in the Golden Gates (1½m) when turned out fairly quickly at Newmarket in July. Since given a break/gelded

Free-going sort. Followed up his Curragh maiden (6f) win for Mrs J. Harrington with handicap/stable debut success at Doncaster (7f) in August. Improved again in defeat when ½-length second in 7f conditions event here lat

races.name: 1xBet.ie Supports Safer Gambling Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict: MOSSY WAY ran to a fair level in 2 maiden hurdles earlier in the year, jumping better on his second outing when third at Fairyhouse in April, and he can build on those efforts to open his hurdles account. Gillane arrives on the back of a bumper win and is next on the list, ahead of Euro Agent.

runners.note: Cloth of Stars gelding. Half-brother to 3 winners, including useful hurdlers Feet of A Dancer and Act of Authority. Looks to face a difficult task on debut.

€20,000 3-y-o, Mahler gelding. Brother to fairly useful hurdler/useful chaser Tightenourbelts, and half-brother to 4 winners, including fairly useful hurdler Miss Goldfire. Runner-up on his completed start in points in M

Has taken a step forward with runner-up efforts in maiden hurdles at Downpatrick the last twice, clear of the rest in 9-runner contest (2¼m) on latest outing. Enters calculations with return to further promising to suit.

Runner up once from 5 starts in point and left behind his first 2 efforts over hurdles when second of 9 in maiden at Downpatrick (2¾m) in August, benefiting from the extra distance. Could be in the mix.

Showed fair form in pair of maiden hurdles for previous yard last year. Didn't need to improve when keeping on well for success in bumper at Bellewstown (17f) in April, but he could yet do better making first start over

Last of 4 finishers completed start in points. Failed to complete on Rules debut, unseating rider at the ninth in hunter chase at Punchestown in May last year. Off 17 months ahead of going hurdling on first run since lea
Off the mark at the fourth attempt in points and looked for one for the longer term sent hurdling when ninth of 12 in maiden at Navan (2¾m) in January. Off 8 months since.

Making third start in bumpers, showed much improved form upped in trip when third of 8 at Downpatrick (19f) in June, though hung left throughout. Has since left James Andrew Fahey and joined a much-respected yard ahead o
€32,000 3-y-o, Joshua Tree gelding. Dam, 2m hurdle winner, half-sister to fairly useful 2m/2¾m hurdle winner Kilbarry Chloe. Runner-up on his sole start in points in May.

Fairly useful bumper winner (trained by P. M. J. Doyle for his victory) who showed the benefit of his hurdling debut effort when third of 25 in maiden at Fairyhouse (2m) in April. Major player with further improvement to

Left his bumper debut behind when runner-up next 2 outings, leaving Brian M. McMahon after his second start. Shaped better than the result when mid-field in a stronger bumper at Punchestown (19f) in May. Could just be be
Point winner (dead-heated) who showed ability on Rules debut when sixth of 12 in maiden hurdle at Downpatrick (2¾m) in July. However, unseated at the first at Navan 13 days ago.
€57,000 5-y-o, Capri gelding. Half-brother to fair 21f chase winner Jezarus, stayed 23f. Point winner at the second attempt in April, so he's one to note on hurdling debut.
Very much in need of the experience on debut when last of 11 in maiden hurdle at Kilbeggan in September, making novicey mistakes. Likely to need more time.
Never better than mid-field on debut when eighth of 16 in bumper at Punchestown in May. Could be one for further down the line as he starts off over hurdles.

Third on his only start in points and was well backed for his bumper debut, but ran no sort of race at Wexford in May. Has since left Ian John McCarthy and interesting to see if the support returns as he goes hurdling.
Made the frame once from 3 starts in bumpers but hasn't offered much in a pair of maiden hurdles, well-beaten twelfth of 20 at Galway (17f) 25 days ago.
Flemensfirth mare. Dam unraced half-sister to top-class hurdler (stayed 21f) The New One and fairly useful hurdler/chaser (stayed 3¼m) The Newest One. Pulled up all 3 starts in points this spring.

Dual point winner who shaped better than the result sent hurdling when ninth of 12 in maiden at Wexford (3m) 5 weeks ago, jumping fluently but not lasting home having kicked on early final circuit. This run should reveal

Finn Ironside is much respected, though, arriving on the back of a second C&D success, with Luminous Warrior another to consider.

runners.note: Best effort when third in handicap at Carlisle (6f) in May but below form since, though possibly needed the run after 10 weeks off when down the field at Thirsk (7f) 18 days ago. Others still more persuasive at present.

races.name: Michael And Esther Cooney Memorial Nursery Handicap
races.verdict: Joseph O'Brien had a nursery debutant win at the weekend and SNAPEQUUS is a similar type who makes most appeal in this field. Littlepacer looked a different prospect last time and can go well again, while Scarlet Dream will appreciate the step up in trip.

Lightly-raced maiden. Ninth of 14 on nursery debut at Naas (5f, good to soft, 20/1) 15 days ago. Up significantly in trip but has work to do.
Well held in 3 maidens whilst shaping as if one for handicaps. He's bred to be useful and yard won nursery with a similar type at the weekend so he's one to be interested in.

Made little impact in maidens but shaped well when third of 12 on nursery debut at Sligo (6f, good to soft) in August, left poorly placed. Merits consideration.

races.name: Smith Brothers / H. Malone Handicap
races.verdict: TRUCIAL PEARL took a step forward when scoring at Ripon in June, the runner-up winning 3 times since, and having not been ideally placed last time she could be up to doubling her tally. Soul Warrior is feared most following his recent Redcar success, while Forever Twenty shaped well over C&D on her penultimate start.

runners.note: Successful on nursery debut at Redcar (6f) a year ago and, fitted with a tongue strap, bounced back to winning ways over 7f at the same course 9 days ago. Could be thereabouts under a penalty.

Little impact in his qualifying runs, but after 3 months off, he found some progress sent handicapping when third of 8 at Wolverhampton 2 weeks ago. Entitled to build on that first run back from a break.
Slowly away and never involved in his 3 starts so far, eighth of 9 in maiden at Wolverhampton 11 weeks ago. Handicaps should be more suitable but will need to take a big step forward.

Well beaten in 3 starts for Jack Channon and, after 5 months off, fared no better with visor applied when eleventh of 12 in handicap here (1¼m) 30 days ago. Switches to blinkers dropped back in trip.

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Star Appeal Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict: DEE'S FUNNY GIRL is the class act having been second in a Group 3 at Ascot in July and could well resume winning ways if bouncing back from a disappointing Deauville effort. Salt Lake is open to further improvement after winning at Naas 15 days ago and poses the main threat, while South Dakota showed an excellent attitude at Roscommon and could have more to offer.

runners.note: Shaped very well when third of 13 in a maiden at this track over 1m on debut in mid-August, finishing well. Takes a significant step up to listed class and drops in trip but is open to improvement for top connections.

races.name: H. Malone Mechanical & Electrical Handicap
races.verdict: Preference is for IZZARI, who confirmed the promise of his previous couple of starts when winning in good style at Southwell last week. Unpenalised for that success, he gets the vote ahead of King Sharja who does have to carry a penalty for his recent victory at the same course. Jamaican Storm is also capable of getting involved.

races.verdict: After a promising second here in August, EMIZA wasn't quite able to match that form upped to 1m at Navan last time, but she's well worth another chance back at 7f. She gets the vote ahead of Ready To Mingle, who could step forward from her recent stable debut, while Eleanor Shelby is interesting on first run for Joseph O'Brien.

races.verdict: AVIATRICE has gained all her 3 career victories here (including over C&D) and is fancied to bag a fourth now returned to this venue on the back of a good eighth in a big-field Leopardstown handicap last time. Mallavelly also has winning form here and rates the main threat, although Temperance is weighted to go well if back to her best and Bear On The Run remains with potential.
